rationale: Roles confirmed against structure: Q and V_a are the two dynamic states (Q under d/dt on LHS; V_a governed by its own state_rhs in the contract), t is the sole independent axis, and R, C, V_emf, Q_0, tau_a, I_leak, alpha_v, I_0, n_id are constants fixed to physical magnitudes. RC = 1s sets the primary discharge timescale; tau_a = 2s makes the dielectric-absorption relaxation comparably slow so V_a evolves meaningfully over the window. Q_0 = 5 matches Q(0), so tanh(Q/Q_0) and exp(Q/(n_id*Q_0)) sit in their sensitive, non-saturated regime. n_id = 1.5 (within the suggested 1.0-4.0 band) sharpens the field-assisted conduction enough to make the new exponential term visible, and I_0 = 1.5 (within the suggested 1e-4 to 1.0 band, nudged just above) is the smallest coefficient that lifts the new-term trajectory effect past 5*sigma without swamping the other mechanisms. t in [0, 10] covers ~10 RC time constants — the exponential term dominates early (Q large), the leakage/back-EMF terms bite in the middle, and the tail settles as Q, V_a relax.
